20001.long_desc: The Game Wizard Mercury 2.0 is a sleek and compact arcade option packing all of the advanced Arcooda features into one versatile cabinet. The Mercury combines arcade/pc/console plug and play capability with a 24" touch screen and accessible USB ports for an infinite combination of gaming options. The Mercury unlocks freedom to game your way. Buttons can be mapped and customized to your liking or you can swap out the entire control panel for racing, rhythm or shooting style controls. Alternatively, the Mercury features accessible USB ports to suit your controller preference with full VR support. This machine boasts a sturdy plywood build with the highest quality Sanwa joysticks and pushbuttons. A 2.1 subwoofer stereo system hits crisp notes and rumbling bass while programmable LED lighting sets the mood for your gaming session. The Mercury 2 is destined to be the centerpiece of the games room. MONITOR: 24" touch screen supports 15khz, 31khz, and up to 1080P HD inputs via VGA and HDMI inputs. This monitor has been designed for arcade gamers featuring 1.3ms response time at 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. CONTROLS: Mercury 2.0 arcade machine features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world's premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble free operation. CABINET: 18mm Plywood construction with a powder coated 2mm steel control panel. Internally, the machine is layered allowing you to update your machine at any time with the Arcooda Game Wizard add-on, or add your own internal functions. With industry standard wheels and internal rear screw down feet, Mercury 2.0 arcade also includes 6 input power board, +5V 20A +12V 8A power supply, 2x 12volt fans. WIRING: The cabinet is designed with Jamma wiring system. The machine also supports JVS wiring system (optional) and Game Wizard (optional) LIGHTING: programmable 12volt LED lighting circuit controlled via blue-tooth phone app, remote control or internal controller. Choose the colour of light, brightness, or pattern. The cabinet body features LED surrounds in the speakers, turn one off, both off, with different patterns, or same pattern. CONTROL PANEL: comes as standard arcade 2 player, 8 buttons per side and is fully Arcooda featured with the Game Wizard options (home, back, start extra buttons per player). Optionally you can add additional pinball buttons to the side of the control panel to play pinball games with all the sensation of playing a real pinball machine The following optional add-ons are available directly from Arcooda; - Arcooda Rear Multimedia Add-On: turn your cabinet into a media center, with HDMI, USB and RJ45 input/output function. Connect your cabinet to your gaming hub, stream your gameplay on secondary monitors and much more. - Custom Artwork: add your own designs to the game header, side art and control panel overlay. Full flexibility is available, you can even put your own face on the cabinet! - Arcooda Pinball Plunger Addon : this small form pinball plunger can be mounted on the front of the Mercury 2.0 to completely transform your lowboy into a mini pinball machine. - Pinball Opto Flipper Button Add-On Kit : replace your pushbuttons with flipper buttons and a working opto system to give your cabinet the real kick of a genuine pinball while playing Disclaimer: All product and company names are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective holders. Use of them does not imply any affiliation with or endorsement by them. On Screen Images are for demonstration purposes only. GameBoard is not included with the purchase of this machine
